claim_text: In RLHF the optimal policy is the reference policy times exp(reward / beta), so a small beta lets one token take the rew

spec.explain: Toy 2-token RLHF from arXiv 2203.02155: optimal policy is softmax of reward/beta. Watch p_top, the top-token share: small beta lets one token take almost all mass.

questions.q: Set beta to 2 and watch p_top. Do you expect the policy to follow the reward more?
questions.why: Tests that larger beta stays closer to reference.

questions.q: Set gap to 2.2 and beta to 1 and watch p_top?
Set beta to 0.4 and watch p_top?
Set gap to 3.3 and beta to 1.6 and watch p_top?
questions.why: Reads how larger gap offsets larger beta.
